From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Matt Delgado (EA) <matt.delgado@orbitaltech.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Run-of-Show and Escort Assignments for CxO Strategic Day

Team —

We have final confirmation from Orbital for the CxO strategy day on Thursday, 5/20. Emily sent the attendee list and flight details (see forwarded below). I want to lock escort assignments and the run-of-show by EOD tomorrow so we have time to print badges and pre-stage the main room.

Immediate asks:
- Laura: can you confirm badge list (names/affiliations) and whether we should print guest badges or order day-of printing?
- Marcus: can you take arrivals (SFO) and be escort lead for the CEO? ETA ~7:45am on 5/20.
- Monica: can you own AV liaison + slide handoff process; I will coordinate with their CTO on USB vs AirDrop.

Attached: run_of_show_v2.pdf (draft), escort_assignments.xlsx (working), venue_floorplan_3rdfl.pdf.

I’ll collate responses and send a single instruction set for the EA escorts and the onsite ops channel.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts (Onsite Ops Lead)

Thanks everyone for the quick responses — final below and attached. Small changes from draft: arrival door is the north arrivals (not valet), and the CEO will go straight to the green room for a 15-minute prep.

Final checklist (ACTION ITEMS):
- Laura: print 30 pre-registered badges and leave with Security (reception table B). Also prepare the one-page dietary list and hand it to catering at 11:15.
- Marcus: meet Pedro at SFO arrivals gate 4 at 07:37; escort CEO to green room via private elevator. Confirm Security has the manifest by Wednesday 16:00.
- Monica: AV tech will be at 08:00 for mic checks; collect USB/airdrop slide deck from CTO by 09:00. Bring a spare laptop (Mac) and HDMI adapter.
- Jordan: I’ll manage the tabletop for the CIO roundtable and be the single escalation for schedule shifts.

Attachments: run_of_show_v2.pdf (finalized), escort_assignments.xlsx (finalized), venue_floorplan_3rdfl.pdf, badge_list_may18.csv.

If no objections, I’ll post this to the onsite-ops channel and print hard copies for the concierge pack.
